title: UAAP: FEU gets share of top spot after beating UP

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University grabbed a share of the early lead in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament after defeating the University of the Philippines, 90-79, on Sunday at Philsports Arena on Sunday. The Tamaraws improved to a 3-1 card, tying Ateneo atop the standings. The win also marked FEU’s first against UP since 2019. “We knew we’d see some tremendous improvements like these because guy are basically trusting one another better now,” said coach Sean Chambers.
